description: Software engineering student at the University of Lahore. I work in Python, data pipelines and time-series analysis. For this challenge we'll build a web tool that pulls NASA Earth data (MERRA-2, GPM, MODIS) for a region, plots it over time, and tests whether the trend is significant (Mann-Kendall). Looking for teammates who know data visualization, front-end work, or Earth science. Joining virtually.
